title: Photo renamer CLI
turns: write a cli in typescript that renames my photos by the date they were taken, e.g. 2024-05-01_001.jpg. dry run by default, only really rename when i pass --apply. skip files with no exif. no dependencies if you can help it, just node

expected_facts.description: Dry run by default, --apply to rename

notes: dev set: written as held-out by a separate agent; used to build lexicon v2
